channel.title: Uphill Pursuit — Adventure Blogs
channel.description: Trip reports from hiking, skiing, mountaineering, and biking across the Cascades, Rockies, and beyond.

item.title: Hidden Lake Lookout Hike — North Cascades, WA
item.description: An 8-mile round trip in Washington’s North Cascades, climbing 3,300 feet through forest and wildflower meadows to the historic Hidden Lake fire lookout.

item.title: Park Butte Lookout Hike — Mount Baker, Washington
item.description: A 7.5-mile round-trip hike in Washington’s Mount Baker area, climbing about 2,200 feet through forest, meadows, and boulder fields to a historic fire lookout.

item.title: Cascade Pass to Sahale Camp — North Cascades
item.description: A demanding 12-mile round trip from Cascade Pass to Sahale Glacier Camp in the North Cascades, climbing 4,000 feet past turquoise Doubtful Lake.

item.title: Hike to Camp Muir — Mount Rainier, Washington
item.description: Hiking to Camp Muir, the rugged base camp at 10,188 feet on Mount Rainier, climbing through snowfields and shifting clouds.

item.title: Biking Sunrise Road — Mount Rainier National Park
item.description: Riding Sunrise Road in Mount Rainier National Park car-free, a 28-mile round trip with 3,083 feet of climbing.

item.title: Christmas 2022 Ski Trip — Salt Lake City, Utah
item.description: A Christmas ski trip to Utah with early-season powder at Alta, Snowbird, Brighton, and Snowbasin.

item.title: Ski Montana — Bridger Bowl and Big Sky
item.description: A tribute to a 69-day ski season based in Bozeman, Montana, from the ridge at Bridger to a May ski tour at Beehive Basin.

item.title: Ski Colorado — Breckenridge, Vail and Keystone
item.description: A first ski trip to Colorado, exploring Vail, Breckenridge, and Keystone, where the Bergman lift leads to a 12,000-foot peak.

item.title: Maroon Bells Hike — Aspen, Colorado
item.description: Exploring the Maroon Bells above Maroon Creek Valley near Aspen, Colorado, along with the Crater Lake Trail and the John Denver Sanctuary.

item.title: Bike Going-to-the-Sun Road, Glacier National Park
item.description: A 23.22-mile ride with 1,827 feet of climbing on Going-to-the-Sun Road in Glacier National Park, while the upper road was still closed to cars.

item.title: Biking Grand Teton National Park, Wyoming
item.description: Riding the paved bike trail in Grand Teton National Park, which runs from Jenny Lake to Jackson, Wyoming, separated from the park road.

item.title: Ski Utah — Alta, Snowbird, Park City and Powder Mountain
item.description: Skiing Snowbird, Alta, Deer Valley, Park City, and Powder Mountain in Utah, including a first snowcat ride off Lightning Ridge.

item.title: Summiting Wheeler Peak — Great Basin National Park
item.description: Camping at the 10,000-foot trailhead and climbing Wheeler Peak, crossing a scree field and scrambling the final steep stretch to a 13er summit.

item.title: Hiking and Summer Skiing on Mount Hood, Oregon
item.description: Hiking toward Illumination Rock, camping overnight, and skiing Timberline Lodge in late June on Mount Hood, Oregon.

item.title: The False Summit of South Sister, Oregon
item.description: Scouting the snow-covered South Sister Summit Trail in June, climbing Lewis Glacier with an ice axe, and turning around at the false summit.
